five_second.sells: online art and mindfulness courses (NeuroGraphica, chakra drawing, manifesting)
five_second.for_whom: people into creative self-development and spiritual/wellness practices
five_second.price_guess: somewhere in the $100-300 range per course, just a guess

errand.abandoned_at: the /login page, right after confirming Forgot Password works - stopped before entering any credentials per session rules (never submit a login)

features_used.moment: Opened the menu and immediately saw 'Library' and 'Log In / Sign Up' listed together near the top, so I knew right away where members go.
Tapped Library from the menu and it routed straight to a login page instead of a dead end or a 404, which told me the content is real and just gated.
Tapped Forgot Password to check my options since I wasn't sure of my saved password on this phone; found a genuine email-based recovery form with a Send Recovery Info button. Did not submit it.
Went back to a clean, stable login form with Email, Password, Remember Me, Submit, and Forgot Password all present and working.

feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: The 'Library' link in the main menu that routed directly to a working login page instead of a dead end

friction.moment: On the very first landing screen, before opening the menu, there was no visible login or account icon - just a hamburger and hero content - so I had to open the menu to find my way in.

delight.moment: The menu had 'Library' and 'Log In / Sign Up' sitting right next to each other, so it was obvious in one glance where returning students go.
The Forgot Password page was a real, functioning recovery form, not a broken link or a vague 'contact us' message.

what_earned_it: Library link in the menu led straight to login instead of a dead end
Forgot Password page had a real, working recovery form
Login page was clean and stable on a second visit
trust.what_it_would_take: Actually logging in with my real password and watching lesson 3 load without a hitch

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's Anna Denning's online school for neuro-art and manifesting courses - if you're already enrolled, the course library and login are easy to find in the menu.
